images.why: Look 'A whole bar labelled 100% across the working area, with the Fold and Cut into ten buttons over it' and Student controls 'fold the whole bar into halves, quarters or tenths, or lay a second whole for double': a bar the child folds and cuts is a satin ribbon, a texture the same everywhere so any fold, tenth, lit part or lifted-off Used part is a slice of one picture (a chocolate bar would put a fold through the middle of a square)
images.prompt: A long straight length of pale golden-yellow satin ribbon with fine woven edges and a smooth, soft sheen that glows gently along its length, the same light buttery gold from end to end.
